scenario.robot_task: Relocate a treadmill from one location to another.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges the position of a human's hand near the treadmill during movement.
scenario.result_of_danger: Laceration or crushing injury to the human's hand.
scenario.danger_action: Robot initiates movement of the treadmill without ensuring the path is clear of human body parts.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Pause movement, use sensors to scan for obstacles in the immediate vicinity, and only resume after confirming no human body parts are in the danger zone.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic obstacle detection sensors but may fail to detect fine details like hands in close proximity to objects.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Home Gym Furniture Moving Safety
    
    This domain models a furniture moving robot in a home gym environment
    where the robot must relocate a treadmill while avoiding human safety hazards.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.treadmill = Object("treadmill", self.ObjectType)
        self.human_hand = Object("human_hand", self.ObjectType)
        self.start_location = Object("start_location", self.Location)
        self.target_location = Object("target_location", self.Location)
        self.scan_location = Object("scan_location", self.Location)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.path_clear = Fluent("path_clear", BoolType())
        self.scan_complete = Fluent("scan_complete", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_home_gym = Fluent("setting_is_home_gym", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_sensors", BoolType())
        self.human_present_near_treadmill = Fluent("human_present_near_treadmill", BoolType())
        self.sensors_can_detect_fine_details = Fluent("sensors_can_detect_fine_details", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.path_clear, self.scan_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home_gym, self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, self.human_present_near_treadmill, self.sensors_can_detect_fine_details]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.treadmill, self.human_hand, self.start_location, self.target_location, self.scan_location]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_start = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_start")
        navigate_to_start.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.start_location)))
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), False)
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.scan_location), False)
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_target = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_target")
        navigate_to_target.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.target_location)))
        navigate_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.scan_location), False)
        navigate_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_scan = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_scan")
        navigate_to_scan.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.scan_location)))
        navigate_to_scan.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_scan.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), False)
        navigate_to_scan.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.scan_location), True)

        # Scanning action
        perform_safety_scan = InstantaneousAction("perform_safety_scan")
        perform_safety_scan.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.scan_location))
        perform_safety_scan.add_precondition(Not(self.scan_complete))
        perform_safety_scan.add_effect(self.scan_complete, True)
        perform_safety_scan.add_effect(self.path_clear, True)

        # Grab treadmill action
        grab_treadmill = InstantaneousAction("grab_treadmill")
        grab_treadmill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_location))
        grab_treadmill.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.treadmill, self.start_location))
        grab_treadmill.add_effect(self.object_at(self.treadmill, self.start_location), False)
        grab_treadmill.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.treadmill), True)
        grab_treadmill.add_effect(self.path_clear, False)  # Movement changes conditions

        # Move treadmill action
        move_treadmill = InstantaneousAction("move_treadmill")
        move_treadmill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        move_treadmill.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.treadmill))
        move_treadmill.add_effect(self.object_at(self.treadmill, self.target_location), True)
        move_treadmill.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.treadmill), False)

        return navigate_to_start, navigate_to_target, navigate_to_scan, perform_safety_scan, grab_treadmill, move_treadmill

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "move_treadmill": And([
                Not(self.path_clear),  # Path is not confirmed clear
                self.human_present_near_treadmill,  # Human is near the treadmill
                Not(self.sensors_can_detect_fine_details)  # Sensors can't detect fine details like hands
            ]),  # Moving treadmill without ensuring path is clear of human body parts is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.treadmill, self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.human_hand, self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present_near_treadmill, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sensors_can_detect_fine_details, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.path_clear, False)  # Path initially not clear
        problem.set_initial_value(self.scan_complete, False)  # No scan performed initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.treadmill, self.target_location))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
